proofs.race_free:
by
  have h : (runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()))).map
      (fun s => raceFree geometry s.trace) = some true := by decide
  cases hr : runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) with
  | none =>
      rw [hr] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp [Option.map])
  | some s =>
      refine ⟨s, hr, ?_⟩
      rw [hr] at h
      simpa [Option.map_some] using h
